WITH ko AS (
  SELECT m.id AS match_id, m.stage, m.winner_team_id, m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id,
         hs.possession_pct AS home_poss, as_.possession_pct AS away_poss

  JOIN world_cup.world_cup.tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id AND t.tournament_year = 2022
  JOIN world_cup.world_cup.match_team_statistics hs ON hs.match_id = m.id AND hs.team_id = m.home_team_id
  JOIN world_cup.world_cup.match_team_statistics as_ ON as_.match_id = m.id AND as_.team_id = m.away_team_id

)

  CASE

    WHEN home_poss = away_poss THEN 'tied possession'
    ELSE 'lower possession won'
  END AS result
FROM ko
ORDER BY match_id;
